blocks.heading: Inside Our Own Swimwear Factory in Guangzhou
paragraphs: These guides are written by the people who make your swimwear. Through our [factory ownership and direct B2B sales](/about-us/), production and export sit inside one company, so the answers on [fabrics and sourcing](/swimwear-fabrics-sourcing/), [certifications](/sustainability/), [development and samples](/development/), quality and delivery come from the factory floor.

blocks.heading: How to Send Your Enquiry Straight to Our Team
paragraphs: Send your brief or tech pack [straight to our team](/contact-us/); we reply within one business day, quote first and move on to your sample once you agree to the price.
